headline: Approve the machining center

sections.title: Recommendation
sections.body: The panel agrees the case clears the hurdle. {{npv}} is positive and {{payback_years}} sits inside {{max_payback_years}}. The stress values {{npv_flows_minus_10}} and {{npv_flows_minus_20}} stay positive, so a condition is not required.

disagreements_addressed: No material disagreement. The sponsor, the stress test, and operations all support approval.
